children: According to Sina Finance, U.S. Southern Command said on X that U.S. forces successfully intercepted a floating refueling station in the eastern Pacific that supported illegal maritime drug smuggling. The statement said intelligence confirmed the vessel was linked to the violent drug trafficking terrorist organization Los Choneros. U.S. forces sank the vessel after clearing it and allowing the crew to disembark. The people evacuated from the ship will be handed over to Ecuadorian authorities.

title: U.S. Says It Intercepted and Sunk Drug-Smuggling Vessel in the Eastern Pacific
